statusLine.command: fmt() { n=$1; if [ "$n" -ge 1000000 ]; then echo "$(awk "BEGIN{printf \"%.1f\", $n/1000000}")M"; elif [ "$n" -ge 1000 ]; then echo "$(awk "BEGIN{printf \"%.0f\", $n/1000}")k"; else echo "$n"; fi; }; input=$(cat); m=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); u=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.input_tokens // 0'); n=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // 0'); c=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.cache_read_input_tokens // 0'); e=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); [ "$u" -gt 0 ] && [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && ctx="$(fmt $u)/$(fmt $n)" || ctx="0/$(fmt $n)"; [ "$c" -gt 0 ] && [ "$u" -gt 0 ] && h=$(awk "BEGIN{printf \"%.2f\", $c*100/$u}") && ch=" cache:${h}%" || ch=""; [ -n "$e" ] && eo=" effort:$e" || eo=""; echo "${m} | ${ctx}${ch}${eo}"
